materiality.reason: The approved creative package resolves the final design decision, freezes the asset-intake scope and exclusions, and advances the workflow to a blocking local asset-verification gate without authorizing implementation.

capture.reason: Material provider-neutral execution knowledge was derived from the authorized persisted decision sources.
capture.minimum_next_path: Review and deduplicate only through loki-continuous-improvement.

claim.statement: The approved creative package contains all 11 dialogue proposals, three expression variants, one neutral nighttime parallax, and one Thorin Cut-In at B10.
Smoke, video, dedicated fade, new audio, new choice art, and frame-by-frame animation remain excluded from the approved package.
The analysis status advanced to approved-for-asset-intake, not approved-for-implementation.
Five approved assets are not locally available, so DG-ASSETS and local RQ-S07 verification block every implementation handoff.
No design question remains must-ask-now; DG-ASSETS is an availability and verification gate, while DG-RUNTIME remains inactive until implementation.
Separating creative approval from asset availability prevents a complete design decision from being mistaken for permission to reference files that have not passed local intake.

attempt.action: Project the full creative-package approval into the technical analysis and advance the workflow to asset intake.
attempt.outcome: Decision markers, frozen paths, exclusions, coverage IDs, and the DG-ASSETS boundary validated successfully; no runtime or asset changed.

resolution.statement: DG-CREATIVE-PACK is resolved with the full package approved for asset intake and the excluded visual and audio additions kept out of scope.

cause.statement: The remaining implementation block is caused by missing local asset availability and required intake verification, not by an unresolved creative decision.

gaps.gap: Five approved assets must be supplied at their frozen paths.
Local RQ-S07 must verify presence, exact case, dimensions, format, alpha contract, and checksums before implementation handoff.
Runtime mechanism selection, implementation, and RQ-P01 through RQ-P09 remain later work.

knowledge.minimum_next_path: Wait for user asset delivery, verify every approved file locally with RQ-S07, and do not prepare implementation unless the complete asset intake passes.
knowledge.reuse_guidance: After creative approval, freeze the exact included and excluded package, change state only to asset-intake readiness, enumerate missing files, and make local asset verification a separate blocking gate before implementation.
knowledge.avoid_next_time: Do not equate creative approval with production authorization, request excluded effects, reference absent assets, or activate runtime validation before assets pass intake and implementation exists.
